proclaim.definition:
v. declare formally; declare someone to be something; of titles
v. state or announce
proclaim.translation:
vt. 宣布, 公告, 宣言, 表明, 赞扬
[法] 宣布, 宣告, 公布

proclaimed.definition:
v declare formally; declare someone to be something; of titles
v state or announce
v affirm or declare as an attribute or quality of
v praise, glorify, or honor
s declared publicly; made widely known
proclaimed.translation: v. 正式宣布( proclaim的过去式和过去分词 ); 显示

proclaimers.definition:
plural of proclaimer
n. One who proclaims.
proclaimers.translation: (proclaimer 的复数) n. proclaim的变形

proclaiming.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Proclaim
proclaiming.translation: v. 正式宣布( proclaim的现在分词 ); 显示

proclaims.definition:
v declare formally; declare someone to be something; of titles
v state or announce
v affirm or declare as an attribute or quality of
v praise, glorify, or honor
proclaims.translation: v. 正式宣布( proclaim的第三人称单数 ); 显示

proclamation.definition: n. the formal act of proclaiming; giving public notice
proclamation.translation:
n. 宣言, 公布, 布告, 公告
[法] 宣告, 宣布, 布告

proclamations.definition:
n. a formal public statement
n. the formal act of proclaiming; giving public notice
proclamations.translation: n. 宣布, 声明, 公告( proclamation的复数形式 )

proclamator.translation: [法] 高等民事法庭的官员

proclamatory.translation: a. 公告的, 宣言的, 布告的

proclinate.translation: a. [动](身体部分)向前的,前倾的

proclination.translation: [网络] 前牙往外倾斜；前牙代偿性倾斜

proclined.translation: [网络] 前倾型；略外斜；门牙有往外前倾

proclitic.definition:
a. Leaning forward; -- said of certain monosyllabic words
   which are so closely attached to the following word as not to have a
   separate accent.
proclitic.translation:
a. 连接发音的
n. 连接发音词

proclivities.translation: n. 倾向, 癖性( proclivity的复数形式 )

proclus.translation: n. 普罗克洛斯陨石坑
